info.description: Lesson video for a position within a Section's Blocks zone (see api::section.section's `blocks` dynamic zone). Wraps shared.cloudflare-video so a section can carry more than one video, each independently placed alongside other block types (image+text, interactive, custom embed).

title.description: Optional heading shown above the video (useful when a section has more than one video block). Falls back to the section's own title in studio-vr when left blank.

caption.description: Optional line shown under the video player. Defaults to a generic "watch first" prompt in studio-vr when left blank.

layout.description: Optional side-by-side placement for this block relative to the next one in the Section's Blocks list — see course.block-layout's own description and STRAPI_SCHEMA_NOTES.md's "Side-by-side block layout" section. Leave unset to keep this block stacked full-width, same as before this field existed.
